title: ENS On Steroids
tagline: A dashboard to boost the power of ENS by showing the community very useful informations.
description: A dashboard to boost the power of ENS by using The Graph and Moralis API. Users will see the newly expired domains and those ENS domains that are soon going to expire. They can control their ENS addresses and see some useful and curious data about the ENS project that is so fundamental for the value and infrastructure of Ethereum. The ENS hall of fame shows also the domains with the longest registration time and the domains with the most expensive registration.
how_its_made:
It uses Svelte as base for a fast and cool website 

The Graph is used to fetch all the ens informations like: fetch expiring ENS domains, soon-to-expire ENS domains, most expensive registrations and longest registrations.

Moralis API used to login and show the ens domains owned by the user. ENS is the base layer of this project.
